summary: VeriGate AI-SDLC v3.1.0 fixes the Windows shlex.split backslash stripping bug (plus list-form verify commands), blocks pytest --help/--version/--collect-only false positives, loads ci-check config and policy from the target base branch (--base), enforces require_review_in_ci=true by default, upserts verify-result.json into .gitignore via install_verigate.py, checks merge-base..HEAD in git-pre-push for new branches without upstream, and fixes Azure Pipelines Build Validation & Automatically Included Reviewers guidance.
